newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P affirms long, short-term ratings on DKB.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms long, short-term ratings on DKB.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Friday it had affirmed its A long-term and A-1 short-term ratings on Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd and its affiliates.
The credit rating firm said the rating outlook remains negative.

The rating affirmation followed announcements by Japanese financial authorities on Wednesday of penalties against the bank for its role in suspected illegal payoffs to a "sokaiya" corporate racketeer.
S&P said, nevertheless, that it does not expect the punishment to have a significant impact on the bank's financial performance in the near term.
The punishment includes suspension of loan activities until the end of this year.
The credit rating firm said the rating outlook was negative because of concern about the bank's asset quality as disposal of a substantial amount of problem loans continues.
S&P also said it is concerned about competitive disadvantage due to the scandal and penalties.
